q15_rejection.reason: Q15 cannot represent the low-frequency, high-Q coefficients required by the supported control range.
evidence: The TPT a3 coefficient is about 1.7e-6 at 20 Hz and 4.8e-6 at 30 Hz in the narrow high-Q region, below one Q15 least-significant bit (about 3.05e-5), so it rounds to zero.
A direct-form b0 is about 1.09e-5 at 20 Hz and Q approximately 120 and also rounds to zero after the required Q15 scaling.
Quantized response sweeps produced zero feed-forward terms or unstable low-band poles; the Width 100 grid reached about 54 dB worst-case response error near 20 Hz.

interpretation: Final corrected object measures 38.1% static and 38.0% moving versus 43.0% baseline (11.4–11.6% relative reduction).
The earlier 33.6% integer result is rejected and is not the installed production implementation.
Device CPU captures use no injected signal; sound/state equivalence is checked separately on the host.
Final plugin installed; temporary benchmark preset removed and matrix_mixer.json restored.

integer_rejection.high_frequency: At 4 bands, Width 200%, Formant +4 semitones, the active top synthesis band near 22.68 kHz requires a coefficient around 684, exceeding postShift 7 representation (128).
integer_rejection.low_frequency: The unshifted 500 Hz rule allows synthesis at 62.5 Hz under -36 semitones. Width 0/Depth 0 showed about 0.552 dB spectral deviation and a persistent tail.
integer_rejection.arithmetic: The SMMLAR accumulator wraps before final saturation; ±16 V input scaling also clips legal +12 dB Pre transients before the smoothed guard settles.
integer_rejection.analysis_only_trial: Keeping synthesis float and using saturated additions plus ±64/128/256 V Q31 scaling did not preserve startup Width-motion behavior: a 2-second stereo ±10 V probe, Pre +12 dB, Width 0, Depth 100, Attack 1 ms, no settling silence measured approximately 22.28 dB active-output SNR versus float at all three scales. The discrepancy decayed as controls settled. This points to realization/state behavior under coefficient changes, not merely input scaling.
integer_rejection.decision: Ship fused float loops. Fixed-point replacement needs a separate design that preserves time-varying filter behavior, coefficient range, and headroom; steady-state transfer-function agreement is insufficient.
